title: A bound from a derivative · Set 3
statement:
If $|f'(x)|\le[$a]$ on $(1,6)$ and $f$ is continuous on $[1,6]$, find the sharp upper bound on $|f(6)-f(1)|$.

[__________]{a}
hints: Multiply the bound on slope by the length.
solution: $|f(6)-f(1)|=5|f'(c)|\le5([$a])$. A line of slope $[$a]$ attains the bound.
